meta.method: z-score against a random client: F = sum(weight*(r-baseline)); S = sqrt(sum(weight^2*variance)); z = F/S. baseline = the tool's own mean over informative answers (reference=mean) or the neutral score 2 plus the tool's average requirement premium (reference=neutral).
